blocking_condition: source materials are non-public/confidential
enforcement: block confidential ingestion
logic: The team needs permission before ingesting confidential materials.

blocking_condition: screening requires at least one source case or public basis
enforcement: block screening decision if no case material indexed
logic: Screening must evaluate a case, not an empty folder.

blocking_condition: heavy diligence needs a rationale or exception
enforcement: require screening rationale or exception
logic: Questions should flow from an articulated thesis/risk, not passive data-room browsing.

blocking_condition: no financial source set or documented alternative evidence basis exists
enforcement: warn at start; block completed financial output without an evidence basis
logic: Financial diligence requires a defined set of financial claims or records to test.

blocking_condition: no commercial claim set, source material, or explicit external-research mandate exists
enforcement: warn at start; block completed commercial output without a defined evidence mandate
logic: Commercial diligence requires claims, source material, or a defined research mandate.

blocking_condition: management, sponsor, or governance counterparties are not identified
enforcement: warn at start; block completed assessment until the relevant actors are identified
logic: Capability and alignment assessment requires knowing who is responsible for executing and governing the case.

blocking_condition: critical financial question exists
enforcement: route question to financial owner; critical status blocks IC not start
logic: Questions guide financial diligence, but diligence can also start from available data.

blocking_condition: critical commercial question exists
enforcement: route question to commercial owner; critical status blocks IC not start
logic: Questions and commercial diligence iterate.

blocking_condition: finding affects earnings/cash flow/debt/working capital basis
enforcement: reopen question register
logic: Financial findings can invalidate or refine the original questions.

blocking_condition: finding affects growth/margin/customer/exit multiple assumptions
enforcement: reopen question register
logic: Commercial findings can challenge growth and valuation assumptions.

blocking_condition: finding affects execution feasibility, capex, synergies or KPI baseline
enforcement: reopen question register
logic: Operational evidence can create new diligence questions.

blocking_condition: finding affects sponsor reliance, governance, management quality or alignment
enforcement: reopen question register
logic: Sponsor/management risk often reframes underwriting rather than simply adding a checklist item.

blocking_condition: final valuation relies on earnings/cash-flow basis
enforcement: allow draft model; block IC-ready valuation
logic: You cannot set final valuation on an unverified or unaccepted earnings basis.

blocking_condition: growth, margin, customer, or exit multiple assumptions are material to returns
enforcement: block unsupported final growth/multiple assumptions
logic: Commercial evidence drives growth/margin/exit multiple inputs.

blocking_condition: capex, synergies, integration, or operating plan materially affects returns
enforcement: require evidence/risk acceptance for operational value drivers
logic: Operational feasibility changes cash flows and value creation.

blocking_condition: leverage, financing condition, covenant or liquidity risk affects returns/downside
enforcement: require debt/covenant terms in model or risk acceptance
logic: Debt terms change return distribution and downside.

blocking_condition: tax affects vehicle choice, leakage, filing obligation, or liability
enforcement: hard-block structure only when material; otherwise warn
logic: Tax is a blocker only where it materially changes economics or feasibility.

blocking_condition: legal rights/liabilities/authority affect structure or signing
enforcement: block signing if legal authority/doc consistency unresolved
logic: Legal rights and liabilities must be reflected in structure and docs.

blocking_condition: security/rights/fees/vehicle affect economics
enforcement: require security economics before IC-ready valuation
logic: Security terms and rights are part of the economics, not a legal afterthought.

blocking_condition: unresolved assumption drives returns/downside or IC recommendation
enforcement: reopen question register or require risk acceptance
logic: The model reveals which assumptions matter and what evidence is missing.

blocking_condition: investment decision concerns capital commitment or material action
enforcement: block decision package without final model or exception
logic: Authority needs a risk/return case.

blocking_condition: critical questions unresolved and not risk-accepted
enforcement: show unresolved questions and require risk acceptance
logic: IC should not unknowingly approve unresolved critical uncertainty.

blocking_condition: binding documents are being finalized, signed, or used to authorize funding
enforcement: allow drafting; block finalization, signing, and funding before approval or a tracked conditional-authority route
logic: Documentation may be prepared in parallel, but binding execution must implement an authorized decision.

blocking_condition: signing/funding requires authority and doc consistency
enforcement: hard-block signing if unresolved
logic: Legal authority and document consistency are hard execution blockers.

blocking_condition: tax structure is material to signed docs or economics
enforcement: block only if material; otherwise note/warn
logic: Tax can be either a true blocker or a review layer depending on materiality.

blocking_condition: a position, cost basis, funding, proceeds, or ownership record is being created or changed
enforcement: allow closing preparation; block position creation or cash release without executed authority and event evidence
logic: Administration may be prepared in parallel, but capital and position records require executed authority or realization evidence.

blocking_condition: monitoring live exposure
enforcement: start monitoring when live/residual exposure exists
logic: Monitoring requires a position and baseline.

blocking_condition: material variance, new money, covenant/liquidity issue, exit process, impairment or time-based review
enforcement: open UR/re-underwriting workflow
logic: Material post-close evidence requires outcome calibration.

blocking_condition: new money, sell, impairment, restructure or material valuation/action proposed
enforcement: route to required authority
logic: Material post-close actions need decision authority.

blocking_condition: UR recommends follow-on, rescue, recapitalization, amendment or restructuring
enforcement: open structure/legal execution branch
logic: New-money and restructuring decisions require updated rights/security/economics.

blocking_condition: approved action requires signed amendment, subscription, commitment or restructuring docs
enforcement: block funding/position update until docs/evidence exist
logic: Post-close action changes exposure and must be documented.

blocking_condition: recommendation is hold/no action/defer or decline support while live exposure remains
enforcement: reset monitoring baseline and risk flags
logic: A hold decision still changes what the system should monitor.

blocking_condition: current analysis recommends sell, exit, realization or write-off
enforcement: open exit-realization workflow and require current sell/hold rationale and return bridge
logic: An approved sell or write-off recommendation starts the exit-realization workflow.

blocking_condition: sale process or realization event appears directly during monitoring
enforcement: open exit workflow and require outcome analysis
logic: Some exit events arise before a formal UR document is produced.

blocking_condition: proceeds, write-off, partial realization or final exposure must be recorded
enforcement: record proceeds/final exposure/closed status
logic: Outcomes must be reconciled into capital records.

blocking_condition: partial exit or residual exposure remains
enforcement: keep residual position in monitoring
logic: Partial realization does not close the workflow.

blocking_condition: a critical operational or execution-feasibility question exists
enforcement: route the question to the operational owner; unresolved critical status blocks decision, not work start
logic: Questions guide operational diligence while evidence can arrive iteratively.

blocking_condition: a critical management, sponsor, alignment, or governance question exists
enforcement: route the question to the assessment owner; unresolved critical status blocks decision, not work start
logic: Management, sponsor, and governance assessment should answer explicit decision-relevant questions.

blocking_condition: a critical legal-rights, liability, authority, or documentation question exists
enforcement: route the question to legal; unresolved signing-critical status blocks execution
logic: Legal work should be driven by identified rights, liabilities, authority, and execution questions.

blocking_condition: a potentially material tax, leakage, filing, liability, or vehicle question exists
enforcement: route the question to tax; block only when the unresolved effect is material
logic: Tax analysis should focus on issues capable of changing economics or execution.

blocking_condition: a critical leverage, covenant, liquidity, or financing-condition question exists
enforcement: route the question to financing; unresolved material status blocks final valuation or execution
logic: Financing work should test the debt and liquidity assumptions that drive returns and downside.

blocking_condition: a critical security, vehicle, rights, fees, or governance question exists
enforcement: route the question to structuring; unresolved material status blocks final economics or documentation
logic: Structure must answer the rights and economics questions created by the investment case.

blocking_condition: a finding changes rights, liabilities, authority, conditions, economics, or execution feasibility
enforcement: reopen or create the affected question and mark downstream blockers
logic: Material legal findings can invalidate assumptions or require a different structure or decision.

blocking_condition: a finding changes leakage, liability, vehicle choice, filing obligations, or execution feasibility
enforcement: reopen or create the affected question and mark downstream blockers
logic: Material tax findings can change economics, structure, or ability to execute.

blocking_condition: a finding changes leverage, covenants, liquidity, financing certainty, returns, or downside
enforcement: reopen or create the affected question and mark model or execution blockers
logic: Financing findings can materially change the risk-return case.

blocking_condition: a finding changes security economics, rights, governance, fees, ownership, or vehicle feasibility
enforcement: reopen or create the affected question and mark valuation or documentation blockers
logic: Structuring findings can change the economics and the rights actually being underwritten.

blocking_condition: debt commitments, covenants, financing conditions, or security arrangements are part of closing
enforcement: block final documentation or closing only when financing terms are material to execution
logic: Material financing terms and conditions must be implemented consistently in the transaction documents.

blocking_condition: transaction documents implement security, ownership, governance, fee, or investor-rights terms
enforcement: allow drafting; block finalization and signing until the approved structure is reflected
logic: Transaction documents must implement the actual security, rights, governance, and economic structure.

blocking_condition: tax leakage, liability, blocker costs, or vehicle choice materially affects returns or feasibility
enforcement: require the material tax effect in the final model or a RiskAcceptanceRecord
logic: Material tax effects change net cash flows, return outputs, or transaction feasibility.
